theory.title: In case e in case of para prevenir problemas
theory.explanation: Usa in case + sujeto + verbo para describir una precaución ante un posible problema futuro: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund (guarda el recibo por si necesitas un reembolso). Usa in case of + sustantivo: In case of damage, contact customer service (en caso de daños, contacta con atención al cliente).
theory.tip: In case + frase con verbo. In case of + sustantivo.

content.passage: When you buy something online, it is sensible to prepare for possible problems. Keep the receipt in case you need a refund, and save the confirmation email in case the order number is required. In case of damage, take photographs before contacting the supplier. If the delivery is delayed, customer service should provide an update. Keep the original packaging in case you need to send the item back.

items.prompt: Explain what you keep in case you need to return a product.
items.modelAnswer: When I buy something, I usually compare prices and read the conditions carefully. If there is a problem, I contact customer service and explain what has happened. I think a good company should listen to customers and offer a fair solution. I keep receipts and confirmation emails in case I need them later. Planning purchases helps me manage my budget and avoid unnecessary expenses.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
